_: Skin of the volar (inner) upper arm and the antecubital side: thin (dermis ~0.84 mm in women, 17-21 % thinner than men's), soft and compliant, sun-protected, hairy-field skin with ~46 follicles /cm2; over a soft fat layer and the biceps. Values: adult woman, relaxed arm. SKIN lane 11-07.

alpha.src: as skin.body (no measurement off the face)

structure.src: SRL upper arm row (F1, F2, F11, MB-R15); LAYERS dermis_mm.upper_arm (Wang S 2023, 104 women, flexor 0.84 +/- 0.15 mm)

kinetic.src: as skin.body (forearm-measured; the inner arm not separately measured)

static.src: static taken equal to kinetic (skin friction is reported almost only as dynamic)

friction.counterface: smooth hard probe as skin.body unless stated

measured_forearm_volar.src: Asserin et al. via search summary: volar forearm vs a silicone reference ~0.7 (one woman, 42 y, preliminary)

v.position: near the positive end (gives up electrons): above nylon-class, below polyurethane foam

triboelectric.src: ALPHALAB09 rows 'Nylon, dry skin' +30 and 'Hair, oily skin' +45 nC/J (72 F, 35 % RH); skin is conductive, so metal rubbing cannot charge it

resistivity_ohm_m.src: 1 / sigma: stratum corneum 2e-4 to 2e-3 S/m and wet skin 0.059 S/m at low frequency (GABRIEL96 via the Frontiers compiled table); DC dry stratum corneum is higher still and falls steeply with depth (YAMAMOTO76, numbers not retrieved)

surface_resistivity_ohm_sq.src: not found: depends on surface moisture; YAMAMOTO76 gives a depth profile, not retrieved

permittivity_rel.src: GABRIEL96 via the Frontiers compiled table (low-frequency relative permittivity, wet skin)

charge_decay_s.src: local: tau = eps0 eps_r rho (wet 8.85e-12 x 1136 x 17; dry stratum corneum rho 500-5000 with eps_r ~ 200-1000, E); whole body: JS001 R C = 1500 ohm x 100 pF; held charge on insulating soles depends on the sole, E

E_kPa.src: FENG22 OCE forearm incl. stratum corneum (small strain)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

compressible_to_fraction.src: a stiff thin shell: thins little under contact (E)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

thickness_mm.src: SOFTTISSUE biceps face 8-18 mm from neighbours (no direct value); triceps face 17.6 F (R44)

E_kPa.src: SOFTTISSUE R31 in vivo fat (gluteal) applied

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

thickness_mm.src: relaxed biceps depth to humerus (E; SOFTTISSUE gives triceps 32 mm)

E_kPa.src: 3 x G 4 kPa relaxed (SOFTTISSUE R25); x5-10 at 3-7 % EMG (R29)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

contact_stiffness_kPa_per_mm.src: series stack of compliance_layers: E_eff = T / sum(t_i / E_i) = 14.78 kPa over T 37.9 mm, / T; initial (small-strain) value; each layer stiffens with strain (fat and muscle stiffen with strain (SOFTTISSUE section 3); muscle activation x5-10)

ramp.src: IPC-style log barrier inside collision_thickness keeps surfaces apart; the tissue's own stiffening (exponential in strain) carries the load beyond it

contact_damping_ratio.src: thigh value (SOFTTISSUE M31); no upper-arm value (SOFTTISSUE: gap)

wave_speed_m_s.src: sqrt(G / rho): dermis 13.3 kPa; BOYER12 reduced modulus 14.38 kPa / 3

damping_ratio.src: thigh value (SOFTTISSUE M31); no upper-arm value (SOFTTISSUE: gap)

membrane_stiffness_N_m.src: E x t = 40 kPa x 0.84 mm: 0.7 x skin.body's 48 N/m - the thin compliant inner arm

model.src: small strain per layer; skin.body's GOH for large stretch

E_kPa.src: BOYER12 air-flow indentation, volar forearm, women 23 y / 60 y (nearest measured site); FENG22

stretch.v: volar forearm and upper arm hold higher Cutometer R5 / R7 (recovery) than the back of the hand (IWAEM22); ventral upper-arm roughness rises ~exponentially with age (SRL, Hoppe via MB)

conductivity_W_mK.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 0.372 W/mK (SD 0.059, 8 studies, range 0.322-0.498); 0.37 kept

heat_capacity_J_kgK.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 3390.5 J/kgK (SD 233, 4 studies, 3150-3662)

density_kg_m3.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 1109 kg/m3 (SD 38, n 10, 1100-1125); ICRU44 ~1090: recalled, not re-read

effusivity.src: sqrt(k rho c) from the three ITIS values above, J m-2 K-1 s-1/2 (the 'feels warm/cold' number)

emissivity.src: STEKETEE73 abstract re-read 11-08 (paper paywalled; abstract text via a reproduction): skin 0.98 +/- 0.01, independent of wavelength over the measured 1-14 um; white, black and burnt skin measured (normal = burnt); separate per-pigment values are not given in the abstract

flexed_biceps.src: 3 x G 22-43 kPa at 3-7 % EMG (SOFTTISSUE R29): a lightly flexed arm, 5-10x stiffer
